capabilities: Convert Markdown files with heading-defined headwords into indexed dictionaries
Look up entries with prefix, fuzzy, and full-text search modes
Look up selected text via context menu or hotkey
Insert definitions into notes as callouts, footnotes, wikilinks, or raw text
Jump between definitions by clicking wikilinks inside the dictionary reader
extras: One-click download of curated sample dictionaries requires an internet connection; all lookup, indexing, and sharing is otherwise fully local. README is duplicated in seven languages and links to a GitHub repository that was stripped from the provided text.
problem: Obsidian freezes for tens of seconds when opening very large Markdown reference files, and there is no built-in way to use plain Markdown files as lookup dictionaries.
summary: Markdown dictionary reader that turns .md files with heading-indexed headwords into offline, searchable dictionaries with fast lookup and citation tools.
